description: Retrieve a KAZM listener's full profile — by listener_id OR by email address. Either identifier works. Use at the start of any session to instantly personalize the experience. If the listener has their KAZM ID saved in Claude custom instructions, use that; otherwise look them up by email.

email.description: Email address — alternative to listener_id. Use if the listener's email is known.

listener_id.description: The listener's unique ID (from register_listener or saved in custom instructions)

name: get_listener_profile
title: Listener Profile
